articles.title: Scientists Burned Scrolls on Purpose — And It Might Unlock a Buried Library
articles.summary: A scientist burned scrolls on purpose to solve a 2,000-year-old mystery. If ancient ink had lead in it, X-rays can read the words without ever unrolling them.

articles.title: NASA's New Telescope Will See What Even JWST Can't
articles.summary: NASA is building a new space telescope called PRIMA that sees far-infrared light — wavelengths JWST can't detect. It could launch in 2033 to study how planets and galaxies form.

articles.title: A Dead Star Is Making a Shock Wave That Shouldn't Exist
articles.summary: Astronomers found a dead star creating a shock wave that shouldn't be possible. It's like a ship's wake in space — but the star has no fuel disc to power it.
